scope: Same fwp program and explicitly selected compiler with numeric collection fusion enabled or disabled, checked ARC, native -O2, no tracing or reuse poisoning. Inputs are compiled constants; range construction, callbacks, sorting, deduplication, one query, startup and output are included in whole-process time. Map and mapped-set variants use the same sorting algorithm. Range-set cases hash all distinct keys: ordinary construction builds a list and sorts it, whereas direct construction writes already ordered integers into one final buffer. The map keeps the last value for each duplicate key; the set keeps distinct keys. Memory uses separate instrumented executables and includes main and shutdown; charged storage excludes allocator capacity and process RSS. Eight samples per variant use recorded randomized order; small inputs may be dominated by startup. Native compilation times exclude fwp C generation; the compiler executable need not itself be a release build to produce the measured native -O2 programs. No C/Rust timing parity, universal speed threshold or register-placement claim follows from this report.
